title: Compare the text itself
summary: Objective-C: Compare the text itself. Change b to dog.
introduction: isEqualToString compares string contents. Pointer equality asks whether two references point to one object.
learningObjectives: Compare the text itself with Objective-C

blocks.text: On a Mac with Xcode command-line tools, save lesson.m. Run clang -fobjc-arc -framework Foundation lesson.m -o lesson, then ./lesson.

blocks.title: Compare the text itself

blocks.text: The second string joins c with at. Content equality finds the same letters in both strings.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Use text equality when you care about the letters, not object identity.
